transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
It's my lower back, mainly. It came on about 10 days ago after I was lifting heavy bags of compost in the garden, and it's been stiff and aching ever since.
When did you first notice it?
About 10 days ago. I noticed it right after I'd been lifting heavy bags of compost in the garden.
Is there anything that makes it better or worse?
Yes, it's worse when I bend or when I'm getting out of the car. It eases off if I lie on my side, and a hot water bottle helps quite a bit.
How would you describe the feeling in your own words?
It's a stiff, aching pain most of the time, but now and then I get a sharp twinge.
Where exactly do you feel it, and does it spread anywhere?
It's across the lower back, more on the left side than the right. It spreads into my left buttock, but it doesn't go down below my knee.
On a scale from 0 to 10, where 10 is the worst, how bad is it?
About a 6 out of 10. It's usually worst first thing in the morning.
Is it there all the time, or does it come and go?
It's mostly there all the time as a dull ache, but I get occasional sharp twinges on top of that.
Has anything else been bothering you along with this?
No, nothing else really. I've had no numbness around the back passage or groin, and no trouble passing urine or controlling my bowels. No weakness in my legs either, and no fever.
Do you see a doctor regularly for any health condition?
Yes, I've got type 2 diabetes, so I see my GP about that fairly regularly. I had a similar bout of back pain about 5 years ago as well, which settled down with physiotherapy.
Which medicines do you take regularly, including any new ones?

For the diabetes, I take gliclazide 80 mg twice a day and metformin 1 g twice a day. And since this back pain started I've been taking ibuprofen 400 mg three times a day, which I got from the chemist.
Are you allergic to any medicines?
No, no known drug allergies that I'm aware of.
Has this changed what you can do around the house or outside?
Yes, quite a bit. I can't do any gardening at all at the moment, and I need help putting my socks on.
Is there anything about this that worries you?
Yes, two things really. I want to know whether I've slipped a disc, and whether I need a scan.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
